# kormium 2026.07.02

- [ADR 0001 — Concrete dialects live in standalone modules](https://github.com/kormium/kormium/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-standalone-dialect-modules.md)
- [ADR 0002 — No `ilike`; case-insensitive matching is explicit via `lower()`](https://github.com/kormium/kormium/blob/main/docs/adr/0002-no-ilike-explicit-lower.md)
- [ADR 0003 — `dialect` is a public member of `Database` / `SuspendDatabase`](https://github.com/kormium/kormium/blob/main/docs/adr/0003-public-dialect-on-database.md)
- [ADR 0004 — Subqueries: correlated `EXISTS` via `any` / `none`, not a subquery-as-value](https://github.com/kormium/kormium/blob/main/docs/adr/0004-correlated-exists-any-none.md)
- [ADR 0005 — No untyped `findById`; single-row reads via typed `findOne`](https://github.com/kormium/kormium/blob/main/docs/adr/0005-no-untyped-findbyid.md)
- [ADR 0006 — No idiomatic-path nudge (no `@RequiresOptIn` marker, no detekt rule)](https://github.com/kormium/kormium/blob/main/docs/adr/0006-no-idiomatic-path-nudge.md)
- [ADR 0007 — `ConcurrencyConflictException` as a typed signal, not a retry helper](https://github.com/kormium/kormium/blob/main/docs/adr/0007-concurrency-conflict-exception.md)
- [ADR 0008 — No `RETURNING` on `UPDATE` / `DELETE`](https://github.com/kormium/kormium/blob/main/docs/adr/0008-no-returning-on-update-delete.md)
